title: Should You Buy SpaceX Stock After Its IPO Pop? History Offers a Clear Answer.
title_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股后你应该购买它的股票吗？历史给出了明确的答案。
summary: SpaceX is unlike any IPO in history, but the past can still provide good evidence for where shares could be heading.
summary_zh: SpaceX 与历史上任何一次 IPO 不同，但过去的经历仍然可以为股价的走向提供良好的证据。

title: Review & Preview: Peace Deal Trumps Fed
title_zh: 回顾与前瞻：和平协议胜过美联储
summary: Progress toward a peace deal with Iran outweighed hawkish undertones from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Plus, the Knicks’ market impact.
summary_zh: 与伊朗达成和平协议的进展盖过了美联储主席凯文·沃什的鹰派暗示。另外，尼克斯队的市场影响力。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq And Dow End Holiday-Shortened Week Higher As Investors Cheer US-Iran Peace Deal — SPCX, AMZN, ONDS, NFLX, TTWO In Focus
title_zh: 由于投资者欢呼美伊和平协议，标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数在假期缩短的一周中上涨 - SPCX、AMZN、ONDS、NFLX、TTWO 成为焦点
summary: Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian signed a preliminary agreement on Wednesday in a bid to end the conflict between the two countries.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安周三签署了一项初步协议，以结束两国之间的冲突。

title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Buys Into UK Rentals With £1.045b Metra Living Deal
title_zh: 摩根士丹利 (MS) 以 1.045 英镑收购英国 Rentals Metra Living 交易
summary: Morgan Stanley Investment Management and Ridgeback Group agreed to acquire Metra Living, the PRS business of London & Quadrant Housing Trust, for £1.045b. The deal expands NYSE:MS into UK residential rental assets at a time of housing supply constraints in key urban areas.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利投资管理公司和 Ridgeback Group 同意以 1.045b 英镑收购 London & Quadrant Housing Trust 的 PRS 业务 Metra Living。在主要城市地区住房供应紧张之际，该交易将 NYSE:MS 扩展到英国住宅租赁资产。

title: Meta Strikes New AI Computing Deals With Data Center Firm Crusoe
title_zh: Meta 与数据中心公司 Crusoe 达成新的人工智能计算协议
